title: Customizations Rethink
description: A · Charter — "What can my agent do here?" The setup reads as five short paragraphs grouped by behavior (Guidance · Skills and agents · Tools and connections · Hooks and schedules), not by file type. Only what's active for the selected harness ("Applies to" Copilot CLI / Claude Code / Codex) is stated as fact; everything else sits under "Not active" with its reason and a selective, copy-creating conversion. Every noun is a token you can inspect, toggle or open. "Needs attention" leads with explicit fixes; Add → Describe It drafts a typed, scoped, harness-valid change you review before anything is written. Vetted and cut by a 4-member design council (2 review rounds).
